commentary.text: 90+11' Pablo Fuertes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

90+10' What a chance that is! Santiago Mourino (Alaves) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post.
90+7' Dani Raba (Leganes) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Antonio Sivera.
90+6' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Munir El Haddadi (Leganes). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

90+5' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes), but referee Pablo Fuertes must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+4' This is a yellow card! Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+2' The game is interrupted now, Joan Jordan (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

90+1' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Joan Jordan (Alaves) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Dani Raba (Leganes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
88' 3 - 3 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Valentin Rosier is pounced on by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes). His close-range header flashes past Antonio Sivera and into the right of the goal. 3:3.
87' Substitution. Carles Alena makes his way off the pitch and Adrian Pica (Alaves) comes on as his replacement.
85' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Javi Hernandez will be replaced by Julian Chicco (Leganes).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Renato Tapia trots off the pitch and is replaced by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes).
84' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
83' Duk (Leganes) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
82' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Leganes players look gutted.
82' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Pablo Fuertes wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
81' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
80' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. Leganes have a free kick from a promising distance.

79' Joan Jordan (Alaves) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. Carlos Vicente (Alaves) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.
78' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) makes a rough challenge and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Alaves.
77' The attendance is 10681.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is coming onto the pitch as Kike Garcia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' The substitution has been made. Duk (Leganes) has replaced Seydouba Cisse.
72' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Juan Cruz and he is replaced by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes).
72' That's the end of the game for Darko Brasanac, who is replaced by Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes).
71' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
68' 2 - 3 Goal! Joan Jordan (Alaves) neatly controls a decent pass from Carles Alena. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the top right corner from the edge of the box. 2:3.
67' Juan Cruz (Leganes) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
65' Dani Raba (Leganes) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
64' Dani Raba (Leganes) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

64' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the right side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
62' A pass from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is intercepted by Marko Dmitrovic and the move breaks down.

61' Renato Tapia (Leganes) was all set to celebrate a sensational goal after he collected a rebound and blasted a shot in from long range. Unfortunately for him, his effort crashed against the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.

61' Dani Raba (Leganes) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
61' A player from Alaves brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Leganes win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
59' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) picks up a yellow card.
57' Borja Jimenez appears to have said too much and referee Pablo Fuertes comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
57' The referee is firm and issues Darko Brasanac (Leganes) a deserved yellow card.
55' Toni Martinez (Alaves) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Moussa Diarra, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
53' Carles Alena (Alaves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
52' A pass from Joan Jordan (Alaves) is intercepted by Marko Dmitrovic and the move breaks down.
50' 2 - 2 Goal! Joan Jordan (Alaves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marko Dmitrovic into right side of the goal.
49' Joan Jordan (Alaves) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
49' Handball by Seydouba Cisse (Leganes). The referee points to the penalty spot. Alaves are awarded a penalty kick!
48' Joan Jordan (Alaves) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
48' Referee Pablo Fuertes sees the trip by Valentin Rosier (Leganes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Alaves have a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Jon Guridi (Alaves) will not participate anymore and Toni Martinez is coming on.
46' Eduardo Coudet has made a change at the break. Santiago Mourino has come on in place of Manu Sanchez (Alaves).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Eduardo Coudet gives a chance to Joan Jordan and Ander Guevara (Alaves) is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+11' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+10' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45+9' A cross into the box from Jon Guridi (Alaves) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
45+5' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Dani Raba (Leganes), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
45+5' Dani Raba (Leganes) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

45+5' Renato Tapia (Leganes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Leganes are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Pablo Fuertes saw the whole situation.
45+2' Kike Garcia (Alaves) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the left post.
45+2' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
45' 10 additional min. will be played.
44' Alaves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
39' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' > receives the ball and produces a long-range shot without any hesitation. His effort heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has a clear view of the shot and makes the save.
37' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Dani Raba (Leganes) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Antonio Sivera no chance!
37' Dani Raba (Leganes) is going to take the penalty!
36' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Leganes!
36' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
36' Eduardo Coudet isn't happy on the touchline after referee Pablo Fuertes shows him a yellow card.
31' Referee Pablo Fuertes makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Leganes. Let’s see what happens!
31' Diego Garcia (Leganes) got into an offside position. It was tight, but it's not the first time he got caught today.
30' PENALTY APPEAL after Diego Garcia (Leganes) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
29' Carles Alena (Alaves) trips an opposition player and Pablo Fuertes signals a foul.
28' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes a short corner kick.
27' Total attempts – 3:7. The current number of shots on goal is 1:4.
25' 1 - 1 What a goal! Carles Alena plays it to Kike Garcia (Alaves), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Marko Dmitrovic into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
24' Dani Raba (Leganes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
23' Diego Garcia (Leganes) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
23' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
21' Diego Garcia (Leganes) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.

21' Jon Guridi (Alaves) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the target, but Marko Dmitrovic keeps the ball out.
19' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Dani Raba (Leganes), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
18' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
18' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Leganes.
15' A pass by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
13' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle as Diego Garcia (Leganes) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Dani Raba (Leganes) puts the ball into the top right corner past the outstretched arm of Antonio Sivera.
10' Dani Raba (Leganes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
9' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
9' The Leganes players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
7' There's a break in play and referee Pablo Fuertes must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Leganes using VAR. This could be interesting!
6' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
6' Dani Raba (Leganes) will take a corner kick.
6' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Good work from Leganes as they win a corner.
5' Jon Guridi (Alaves) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic makes a comfortable save.
3' Jon Guridi (Alaves) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
2' Dani Raba floats over the corner and Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
2' Dani Raba (Leganes) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
